prompt: Car Settings (com.example.carsettings) closed by itself on a test unit right after the driver opened the display page. logcat.txt is the full logcat from that unit; other apps also logged exceptions during the drive. What exception crashed Car Settings, and at which source file:line in Car Settings' own code did it start? Answer in one line. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException (Invalid brightness level -12, wrapped in a RuntimeException from resume), from BrightnessController.applyLevel at BrightnessController.java:173.
